## File: facebookresearch_parlai/parlai/tasks/nli/agents.py

Prompts

```
['run the NliTeacher multi-task teacher combining ANLI, MultiNLI, SNLI, and DialogueNLI datasets', 'run the NliTeacher with dialog-format flag to convert NLI data to dialogue format without special tokens', 'run the NliTeacher with binary-classes flag to use contradiction and not_contradiction label candidates', 'review the NliTeacher add_cmdline_args method that adds dialog-format and binary-classes arguments to the parser', 'run the DefaultTeacher which is an alias for NliTeacher combining all NLI datasets']
```

